# Locality_Preserving_Teleportation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A teleportation protocol that preserves the spatial locality of quantum information during transfer, avoiding non-local spreading of entanglement. Critical for iNEST neuromorphic systems where local processing and memory must maintain spatial coherence to mimic biological neural networks.
